# Automotive & Transport

From body repair to component production, we supply abrasives and air tools for paint preparation, blending and deburring.

## Recommended products

- [Flap Disc](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/flap-disc.md): Flap disc for angle grinders that combines grinding and finishing in one step on welds, edges and flat surfaces.
- [Pneumatic Die Grinder](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/pneumatic-die-grinder.md): Compact air-powered die grinder for deburring, porting and finishing in tight spaces, compatible with mounted points and small abrasive wheels.
